channel.title: AI News Digest
channel.description: Official AI product updates from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and GitHub

item.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
item.description: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.

item.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
item.description: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.

item.title: Dedicated Memory Bank functionality in the Google Cloud console
item.description: Feature Dedicated Memory Bank functionality in the Google Cloud console You can create, configure, and inspect Agent Platform Memory Bank instances from the dedicated Memory Bank page in the Google Cloud console, with updated memory management controls for deployed agents in Agent Runtime: Memory Bank list and creation: View and manage standalone memory banks on the Memory Bank page (separate from deployed agents on the Deployments page), edit basic information or labels, delete instances, and...

item.title: Usage metrics API flags telemetry and version gaps
item.description: The Copilot usage metrics API now shows which users are missing client telemetry or are running IDE or extension versions below the usage metrics minimums. New per-user fields appear in enterprise and organization user reports, and daily affected-user counts appear in enterprise and organization reports.

item.title: Usage metrics API adds code review details and addressed rate
item.description: The enterprise and organization repository-level Copilot usage metrics reports now show what happens to Copilot code review feedback. A new copilot_code_review object on each repos-1-day row reports how many Copilot-reviewed pull requests merged without a later change request from a person and how many Copilot code review comments developers acted on.

item.title: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure
item.description: OpenAI introduces its National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint to protect local resources, create jobs, and guide responsible AI infrastructure development.

item.title: Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
item.description: Merge uses GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, and Codex to review product code and support marketing. Its teams also use AI to plan executive dinners and prepare sales updates.

item.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
item.description: Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber, OpenAI’s cybersecurity model for finding exploitable vulnerabilities and developing fixes, trained to stay within authorized scope.

item.title: Franklin Templeton uses OpenAI to support investment research
item.description: Starting with equity research, Franklin Templeton is developing AI workflows to help portfolio managers compare research views and examine investment risks.

item.title: Flipsnack grows product signups with conversion optimization
item.description: Flipsnack focused its ChatGPT Ads campaigns on getting people to try its product, growing registrations while lowering the cost per signup.

item.title: Cult.fit builds operational muscle with Codex
item.description: Cult.fit is using Codex to help teams across functions build tools, move faster, and change how work gets done.

item.title: GPT-6-Cyber, Daybreak setup
item.description: Use GPT-6-Cyber to investigate vulnerabilities, reproduce them in an authorized test environment, and verify fixes. See Daybreak setup before sending your first request.

item.title: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
item.description: Australian universities are expanding access to ChatGPT and bringing AI into teaching and learning to prepare students for an AI-enabled workforce.

item.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
item.description: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips

item.title: Admin API reference
item.description: You can now sign a member of your Claude Enterprise (claude.ai) organization out of Claude everywhere with the Admin API. This capability is in beta. See the Admin API reference. The member stays in the organization and can sign in again. See Sign a member out everywhere for the beta header and what the request doesn’t end.

item.title: IP allowlisting
item.description: You can now set up an IP allowlist for your organization in the Claude Console, in beta. Requests to covered services from addresses not on your list are refused, which limits where a leaked API key can be used. Add IPv4 and IPv6 addresses or CIDR ranges, up to 1,000 per organization. See IP allowlisting for what’s covered and how to set it up.

item.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
item.description: OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company, expanding Codex’s tools for building, understanding, and reviewing code.

item.title: Introducing Images 2.6
item.description: Images 2.6 brings faster image generation, GIF creation, more precise editing, and new API controls across ChatGPT, Codex, and the API.

item.title: Daybreak Red is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
item.description: Daybreak Red brings GPT-5.6 Cyber to approved customers in AWS GovCloud (US-East) through Amazon Bedrock for authorized cybersecurity work.

item.title: GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst, GPT-Image-2.6 Flare
item.description: Released GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst and GPT-Image-2.6 Flare for image generation and editing, with adjustable complexity, SVG generation, and animated GIF generation. Added markup-guided editing for supported GPT Image 2.5 and 2.6 models.

item.title: A thousand fewer paths to root
item.description: OpenAI built an autonomous pipeline that found, validated, and generated patches for 948 local privilege-escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel.

item.title: GitHub Copilot is now available in Xcode’s coding assistant
item.description: You can now work with GitHub Copilot directly in Xcode’s built-in coding assistant, bringing Copilot into your native Xcode workflow. The integration is now in public preview, available starting with Xcode 27.3 beta.

item.title: BYOK and enterprise custom models in the Copilot usage API
item.description: The Copilot usage metrics API now shows bring your own key (BYOK) usage across GitHub Copilot, so you can separate it from Copilot-hosted model usage. Reports cover two kinds of BYOK: Local BYOK is configured by developers in their client.

item.title: OpenAI appoints Jill Hazelbaker as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer
item.description: Jill Hazelbaker will join OpenAI as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer, leading the company’s global communications and corporate positioning.

item.title: Heimstaden is changing residential real estate management with AI
item.description: Discover how Heimstaden uses OpenAI’s ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to transform property management, cut costs, and empower employees across Europe.

item.title: How Cisco defends at machine speed with OpenAI
item.description: Cisco combines network intelligence with OpenAI models to strengthen enterprise security. Learn how it is building more adaptive defenses.

item.title: Accelerating engineering for the physical world
item.description: Discover how ChatGPT and Codex are helping engineers accelerate CAD, PCB design, simulation, and other workflows across the physical world.

item.title: GitHub Copilot is now available in JetBrains Air
item.description: You can now delegate coding tasks, guide execution, and review results with GitHub Copilot in JetBrains Air. The integration uses the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) and supports tasks in your JetBrains IDE or in the cloud.

item.title: Dependabot version updates support Agent Package Manager
item.description: You can now keep your AI agent skills, prompts, and instructions up to date with Dependabot version updates for Agent Package Manager (APM). Dependabot opens pull requests to update supported git dependencies declared in apm.yml and regenerates apm.lock.yaml when it’s present.

item.title: CodeQL 2.27.3 adds Python 3.15 features and JSON data extensions
item.description: CodeQL is the static analysis engine behind GitHub code scanning, which finds and remediates security issues in your code. We’ve recently released CodeQL 2.27.3.

item.title: temperature
item.description: Text generated by Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 4.7, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 carries Anthropic’s text watermark on the platforms listed in How Claude marks AI-generated content. On Claude Sonnet 4.6, text generated for a request that sets temperature, top_p, or top_k to a non-default value might not carry it. See Text watermark.

item.title: Scaling Git at OpenAI
item.description: How OpenAI built Pando, a Git-compatible backend designed for the scale of development that Codex makes possible.

item.title: Rewarding defenders with bigger bug bounties
item.description: OpenAI is raising Security Bug Bounty rewards and introducing report quality, loyalty, and priority campaign bonuses for independent security researchers.

item.title: Preparing our next security sprint to harden OpenAI
item.description: OpenAI is preparing its next internal security sprint with Cathedral Systems to test and strengthen its defenses using AI.

item.title: LifeVal
item.description: Introducing LifeVal, a benchmark measuring how well AI helps people complete everyday tasks, from finding childcare to managing finances and government paperwork.

item.title: Introducing the Grid Protectors Program
item.description: OpenAI’s Grid Protectors Program will work with utilities to help future compute campuses support grid reliability and protect consumer electricity costs.

item.title: OpenAI appoints Dan Driscoll as Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization
item.description: OpenAI appoints Dan Driscoll to advise on responsible AI for national security modernization, cyber resilience, and collaboration with U.S. allies.

item.title: SIP guide
item.description: Outbound SIP calling is now available to all organizations through the Live API. Connect GPT-Live to a phone number through your SIP provider.

item.title: The latest AI news we announced in October 2026
item.description: Here are Google’s latest AI updates from October 2026

item.title: message-threads-2026-08-12
item.description: Long conversations and agent loops on the Messages API can now send smaller requests and get a lower time to first token with message threads, in beta with the message-threads-2026-08-12 beta header. The API keeps the conversation on the server, so each later request sends only the new messages. A thread expires 5 minutes after its last request and is deleted no more than 1 hour after its last use.

item.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
item.description: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal to help website operators communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers.

item.title: Fair use benefits everyone
item.description: OpenAI shares excerpts from court briefs by creators, academics, accessibility advocates, and legal experts, among others, on how fair use supports AI training and innovation.

item.title: Community safety report and new protections for teens
item.description: OpenAI is strengthening violence prevention in ChatGPT with expanded safeguards, earlier interventions, and a new commitment to public safety reporting.

item.title: automatic review guide
item.description: Added automatic review for eligible Agents API projects. Set the session's review field to "auto_review" to have a model approve or deny supported tool and permission requests based on conversation intent and risk.

item.title: GPT-6 Rosalind, trusted-access program
item.description: Released GPT-6 Rosalind, bringing specialized biological reasoning with scientific tool use to complex life sciences research. Access is available to organizations approved for Rosalind Research through the trusted-access program for internal research by authorized users.

item.title: update the tools in an existing session
item.description: You can now update the tools in an existing session in the Agents API public beta. Updates replace the full tool list.

item.title: claude-opus-4-8
item.description: We’ve deprecated fast mode for Claude Opus 4.8, with removal on November 30, 2026. After removal, requests to claude-opus-4-8 with speed: "fast" will return an error. To continue using fast mode, migrate to Claude Opus 5.5. Read more in Fast mode model availability.

item.title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
item.description: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.

item.title: How Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence
item.description: Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence with OpenAI. Lawyers review grouped documents, summaries, and reports before advising clients.

item.title: How we detect frontier model misalignment
item.description: OpenAI uses layered monitoring to detect frontier model misalignment and unauthorized agent behavior so responders can intervene before incidents escalate.
